d.subject: Focus decision: ordered hinge batch replay side-effect isolation
d.head: 98a7c1cde9fd36d47562b40fa25ed0b094038e70
d.gap: Non-overflow ordered hinge batches replay each semantic sample through a side-effecting coordinator; intermediate historical states can enqueue privileged actions before later samples in the same batch reverse/supersede them. Rendering is final-sample-collapsed, actions are not.
d.boundary: Pure queue/controller/action-trace integration; no production writes; no physical-device claims.
d.firstTest: Adversarial under-capacity close-then-reversal batch; compare current per-sample action trace with final batch semantics.
